subject: English
passage: How do marine biologists track the migration patterns of deep-sea creatures that live thousands of meters below the ocean surface? Traditionally, scientists relied on studying specimens caught in fishing nets, but in 2019 a research team at the Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution attempted something ______ the bioluminescent signals produced by these elusive organisms.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation:
Choice A is the best answer. "A research team...attempted something innovative" is an independent clause leading to an explanation of what the innovative thing was. A colon can only be used at the end of an independent clause, and typically introduces further explanation that expands upon the first clause, which makes a colon the perfect choice here.

Why B is incorrect:

Choice B is incorrect. This choice results in a punctuation error. "Tracking...elusive organisms" can't stand on its own as a sentence, and so it can't be linked to the independent clause "a research team...attempted something innovative" with a semicolon. Only two independent clauses can be connected in this way.
